name: Boku to Sannin no Onee-sama ~Oneesan-tachi to Haramase OK Yome Erabi Dousei Life!~
original_name: ボクと三人のお姉さま ～おねえさん達と孕ませOK嫁選び同棲ライフ！～
source: The protagonist, Kaguragi Akira, is the heir to the global company Kaguragi Group which holds vast assets. According to the family tradition, he left his parents to live a common life for social training. His caretaker, the aunt Kenzaki Akane, informs him that his father, Kaguragi Takahiko, the top executive, has fallen critically ill and needs to name a successor soon. The company's management insists on a blood relative as his successor, and specifically, his future wife, so she requests Akira to choose a bride from two candidates. Although Akira is hesitant and is having difficulty finding a girlfriend since he lives the life of an ordinary student, he ultimately decides to select a future wife to put his ailing father at ease. Two women make it to the final list: Astrid Nordgren, a daughter of the leader of a foreign company, and Yamashiro Wakaba, daughter of a prominent hospital director, whom his father admirers. Their behavior during the interview is unexpected, and Akira struggles to manage their responses, causing him great confusion. He knows that his future life will be far from dull.
translation:
主人公神乐木旭是拥有庞大资产的全球企业神乐木集团继承人。按照家族传统，他离开父母，过普通人的生活接受社会历练。照顾他的阿姨剑崎茜告诉他：父亲神乐木隆彦、集团最高管理者，病重垂危，需要尽快指定继承人。公司管理层坚持继承人必须有血缘关系，尤其要求他指定未来妻子，因此茜要求旭从两名候选人中选择新娘。

旭虽然犹豫不决，也因为过着普通学生生活而难以找到女友，但最终决定选出未来妻子，让病重的父亲安心。进入最终名单的两人是：外国公司领导人的女儿阿斯特丽德·诺德格伦，以及父亲仰慕的著名医院院长之女山城若叶。她们在面试中的表现出人意料，让旭难以应对，陷入极大困惑。

他知道未来生活绝不会无聊。
